shared_shelf_rule: Use identical points, original per-point area weights and ordering in the two conditions. Reference eligibility is the intersection of source points visible in each condition across the common independent camera lattice. Include both predeclared side witnesses and the start in that lattice.
global_reference_rule: Use each condition's own independent source-scene visible reference for scene F1, including its board when present. The shelf denominator is held fixed within a pair.
